sentences.en: Can you give me a brief description of the thief?
sentences.zh: 你能给我简要描述一下那个小偷吗？

sentences.en: The fear we felt at the earthquake was beyond description.
sentences.zh: 地震时我们感到的恐惧无法用言语形容。

sentences.en: Descriptions can be analysed in terms of the features mentioned.
sentences.zh: 可以从提及的特点来分析这些描述。
